thread:
ops-bot: ALERT P0 — Region rollout anomaly: eu-west blue->green weight shift detected, 6.2% of requests are returning 502/504s. Auto-rollback did not trigger (threshold 10%). Investigating.

raj: acked. paging now. I'm oncall and joining. Can someone drop initial impact numbers?

emma: I see elevated 5xx from 02:03->02:08 UTC across gateway nodes eu-west-1a/b. ~2.1k errors over 5m. Latency p95 spiked from 180ms -> 1.4s.

raj: thanks. Any customers reporting missing responses? Miguel, any alerts in support?

miguel: Not yet high priority, a couple of error-rate tickets for EU customers. No financial impact tickets yet.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-145 — eu-west rollout splitback abnormality. Priority P0. Runbook: check routing weights, feature flags, proxy config.

raj: I'm going to pause rollout and flip the routing kill-switch for eu-west green. Doing: `redwoodctl rollout pause --region eu-west --id rollout/2026-03-02`

sophia: If the pause doesn't drain in 30s, we should set route weight to 0 for green and bounce edge config.

raj: running weight flip now:```bash
# set green weight to 0 to force all traffic back to blue
redwoodctl routing set-weight --region eu-west --variant green --weight 0.0 --reason "emergency splitback"
```

ops-bot: COMMAND LOG — `redwoodctl routing set-weight` accepted. New weights: blue=100.0%, green=0.0%. Propagating to edge.

emma: I can already see error rate dropping on the canary slice. p95 latency back to ~220ms. 5xx counts decreasing.

miguel: Support notified customers in impacted EU clusters: "We're investigating increased errors for some requests in EU. We've applied an immediate rollback to stable variant and are monitoring.", sent to #cust-notify.

raj: Good. Now checking why auto-rollback threshold (10%) didn't trigger earlier. Pulling canary controller logs.```
GET /internal/canary/status?rollout=2026-03-02
# controller logs show partial heartbeat timeouts to edge-proxy during rollout window
```

sophia: That matches: during the rollout window, two edge nodes in eu-west reported control plane heartbeats delayed ~40s due to an unrelated infra maintenance. The orchestrator interpreted partial responses and advanced weights unevenly.

emma: So it's a race: orchestration saw nodes healthy, pushed green weight, but proxies weren't fully ready and started returning 502s.

raj: Root cause hypothesis noted. For immediate mitigation we've done weight flip. Next steps: 1) run targeted DNS flush & edge config sync, 2) validate canary controller anti-race checks, 3) follow-up postmortem.

ops-bot: NOTE — scheduled DNS TTL was 10s for eu-west edge. Flushing cache recommended.

miguel: I've asked CDNs and internal DNS to flush. Command run: `dnsctl flush --zone eu-west`

emma: Doing healthchecks on a subset of customer flows now: auth, embeddings, inference. Auth looks stable, inference p50/p95 acceptable. One internal job still shows retries.

raj: I'm going to hand off primary incident lead to emma — need to catch 02:30 meeting. Emma, take over?

emma: Taking over. Raj — please post any artifacts you have (controller logs, edge heartbeat traces) in the incident doc.

raj: Posted logs to INC-2026-145/docs and link in thread. Also added commands I executed.

ops-bot: On-call handoff recorded: from raj -> emma at 02:18 UTC.

emma: Quick customer impact summary for postmortem: approx 2k failed requests over 7 minutes, ~0.15% of global traffic, concentrated in eu-west for a subset of routes (generation endpoints). No data loss. Some customer requests retried and succeeded.

sophia: We'll treat this as a release/rollout policy bug: orchestrator allowed weight transitions when edge heartbeats were stale. Action items: block weight >0 until all edge nodes report fresh heartbeats (<10s), add stricter observability alerts for partial success rate during rollouts, and add automated rollback at 5% error for 3 consecutive minutes.

miguel: Support note prepared and queued for affected customers, including timeline and mitigation.

emma: Monitoring: keep eyes on 5xx and latency for next 30m. If anything reoccurs, we'll escalate to full rollback of the rollout object and open a SEV ticket.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status: mitigated, playback: rollback of green weight completed at 02:12 UTC, error rates declining.

emma: Closing timeline: root cause preliminary = rollout progressed while edge heartbeat lagged due to maintenance; orchestration lacked anti-race guard. Containment = weight flip and DNS flush. Next = postmortem, rollout policy change, controller patch.

sophia: I'll own the controller patch with Raj's help. Target PR by EOD.

raj: I'll add test coverage for simulated heartbeat lag in canary controller tests.

miguel: I'll coordinate customer comms and postmortem distribution.

emma: Thanks everyone. I'll keep monitoring and will update INC-2026-145 with final postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
